Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?

Effect: When this card would be played, if you have a face-up [Wind Guardians] security card, reduce the play cost by 4.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any Digimon suspend, you may delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon.
